catalog_entities_archive_state.name: catalog_entities_archive_state
catalog_entities_archive_state.value: ("catalog_entities"."state" = 'archived' and "catalog_entities"."archived_at" is not null) or ("catalog_entities"."state" <> 'archived' and "catalog_entities"."archived_at" is null)

entity_aliases_value_length.name: entity_aliases_value_length
entity_aliases_value_length.value: char_length("entity_aliases"."alias") between 1 and 160 and char_length("entity_aliases"."normalized_alias") between 1 and 160

identities_email_shape.name: identities_email_shape
identities_email_shape.value: "identities"."email_normalized" is null or ("identities"."email_normalized" = lower("identities"."email_normalized") and char_length("identities"."email_normalized") between 3 and 320)

identities_email_otp_is_verified.name: identities_email_otp_is_verified
identities_email_otp_is_verified.value: "identities"."provider" <> 'email_otp' or ("identities"."email_normalized" is not null and "identities"."email_verified_at" is not null)

users_deleted_state_consistent.name: users_deleted_state_consistent
users_deleted_state_consistent.value: ("users"."status" = 'deleted' and "users"."deleted_at" is not null) or ("users"."status" <> 'deleted' and "users"."deleted_at" is null)
